events.body:
🎉 Great news! Your issue report has been accepted.

Your SOL bounty has been reserved and is waiting for you.

To claim your reward:

1. Log in to your ForkMesh account.
2. Add your Solana wallet to your profile.
3. Your bounty will be ready to claim.

Thanks for contributing and helping improve the ecosystem! 🚀
events.title: Issue bounty
